name: Spectra
review:
A light show on 30 lines, with stacked wilds that nudge into place and trigger respins.

The nudging wilds give it a hypnotic, steady rhythm, matched by the glowing visuals and synth soundtrack. There's no free spins round to chase; the respins are the feature. Medium volatility, 2,400x cap and a 96.4% RTP make it a calm choice for long sessions. Simple, but very easy on the eyes.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
